label: Splitting at the median
subgoals: Sort the points by the splitting coordinate
Take the middle point as the split
Assign smaller coordinates left and larger right

label: Alternating axes
subgoals: Take the points on one side of the root split
Sort them by y and take the median
Record that split as the child's splitting line

label: Pruning a nearest-neighbour search
subgoals: Find the candidate distance from the query's own cell
Compute each other cell's L1 distance from the query
Search only the cells closer than the candidate
